fileOperationSpec.description:
{@link FileOperationSpec} for tuning the registration and loading of a single {@link File} between
{@link ModelRegistryService} and {@link ModelRegistry}.
If no spec is provided, default value of 60 minutes is used for retries.

batchOperationSpec.description:
{@link ModelRegistry.RegisterLoadBatchSpec} for tuning batch job for registration and loading of many {@link File}s between
{@link ModelRegistryService} and {@link ModelRegistry}.
This spec if used if {@link #enableBatchJob} is set to True.

enableBatchJob.description:
If True, enables model files within a single {@link AtomicPipe} to be registered into or loaded from
{@link ModelRegistryService} using a batch job. For instance, a single {@link AtomicPipe} encompassing a large language
model may contain many model files, and setting this flag uses a batch job to register or load such files,
potentially reducing the latency of register and load operations.

title: Spec for registering and loading file artifacts between ModelRegistryService and ModelRegistry.
name: ModelRegistry.RegisterLoadSpec
